summary: 47-year-old Winter Park man seriously injured in an ATV rollover on CR 22 north of Kremmling; GCSAR staged an ATV evacuation but the patient was flown to Denver instead.
location: CR 22 north of Kremmling, Grand County
notes: Two posts describe the same mission: an initial 'responding to ATV accident north of Kremmling' post (16:48 MDT 2020-05-03) and a detail post that evening (21:21 MDT) describing 'today's mission' as the ATV rollover. Grand County EMS drove the rough road to the site; patient flown to Denver. Team's first mission under COVID protocols.
